SLUG chisato — Chisato, SMG / Burst III / Attacker / Iron, ammo 120, reloadFrames 81, normalMult 10.12, coreMult 250, burstCd 40s. Board: 0.968 COLD on 3 graded comps (0.95 / 0.96 / 0.99). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/chisato.test.ts (20 pins); the open levers are the derived Extrasensory drain, the hit-rate magnitude, and the cadence tuple, all ⚑ below.
EXTRASENSORY (self-status proxy — classification: BOUNDED-APPROXIMATION, exact under her graded cadence). The kit charges it to 100% at battle start, drains it 1%/2s (0.5%/s), and her OWN burst recharges it to 100%. From 100% the >70% ATK 53.69 / >55% True Damage 48.62 / >25% Hit Rate 22.37 gates cross their thresholds at t≈60 / 90 / 150s. Encoded as FUSED PASSIVES — a passive buff honors an explicit durationSec, so each is live from frame 0 and expires at 60 / 90 / 150s — PLUS a burstCast skill1 block that re-applies all three (same buff keys, so they refresh) on every one of her own casts. One model reproduces both regimes: when she bursts each rotation the refresh beats the shortest fuse and all gates stay permanently cleared; in never-burst comps they correctly lapse at 60 / 90 / 150s. On her graded comps she casts at t≈3.6 / 33.7 / 63.3 / 93.7 / 124.5 / 155.0s (~30s apart, inside the 60s ATK fuse), so the decay is inert there and only bites in under-burst comps such as N2 modernia-wind, where modernia takes the B3 slot. The fused-passive trajectory is equivalent to a literal Extrasensory resource pool — same observable lapse ladder. ⚑ the 0.5%/s drain and the gate thresholds are DERIVED from kit text, not measured; the crossing times are exact GIVEN the drain rate, and the drain rate is the kit's own stated 1%/2s.
NOT ENCODED (folded into the derivation or genuinely skippable): the battle-start charge line and the 1%/2s drain line are currency bookkeeping the fuse durations already express; the burst's 'Charges Extrasensory to 100%' is the refresh block; the 100%-only 'Dodging Bullets: Invulnerable 2 sec' is invulnerability, inert with no HP pool.
HIT RATE 22.37 is modeled as hitRatePct and is LIVE via CONE_DELTA — it feeds her SMG core rate through acrForHR. In-game magnitude ⚑.
S2. (a) 'Normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec' on burstCast = a same-weapon weaponSwap, damagePct 10.12 (exactly her own normal multiplier, so the gun is unchanged) + trueNormals, 10s — the takina-precedent encoding. The flavor gate is the point: it makes her permanent S1 trueDamagePct 48.62 apply to normals ONLY inside the window (≈+48.62% damage-up on ~10s of every 40s of normals). A trueNormals same-weapon flavor swap does NOT refill the mag — the engine skips the swap-start refill for trueNormals swaps and treats the exit as a flavor swap with no free reload either — so the window carries no shot-count optimism. (b) hitCount-48 → 472.18% flatDamage, flavor 'true', FB-by-timing (no noFb), permanently boosted by the flavor-gated 48.62.
TRUE DAMAGE CRITS AND CORES in this engine, for both her swap normals and the S2 rider: no `crit && !trueFlavor` guard exists, and true damage critting is owner-ruled in-game-confirmed. The trueNormals / flavor:'true' ENCODING here is faithful either way; whether true damage should core is an ENGINE-fidelity ⚑ out of this override's domain, and with SMG coreMult 250 it is a big lever.
BURST: her own burstCast, self atkPct 73.16, 10s.
⚑ CADENCE TUPLE: SMG class pullsPerSec + reloadFrames 81 + rolling reload are datamined, not measured; a 120-round mag at class rate is ≈9-10s, plausible, with no escalation tells.
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured charFixes.pullsPerSec, so the engine's swap-cadence branch resolves to her ordinary SMG class default. The 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her.
RAMP: she has no stack-ramp line. Her S1 gates are at full value from t=0 because the KIT charges Extrasensory to 100% at the start of battle, so the t=0 full-value encoding is kit-exact, not a bake-at-cap approximation.

skill1: Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Charges Extrasensory to 100%, up to 100%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Only when at 100%: Dodging Bullets: Invulnerable for 2 sec.

caveats: skill1: the Extrasensory threshold buffs (ATK 53.69 / True Damage 48.62 / Hit Rate 22.37) are modeled as FUSED PASSIVES — live from t=0, expiring at 60 / 90 / 150s, the derived >70% / >55% / >25% crossing times of the kit's 0.5%/s drain — and REFRESHED by her own burstCast, which recharges Extrasensory to 100%. This reproduces both regimes: permanent while she bursts each ~40s rotation, decaying off when she never bursts.

skill2: 'Normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec' is encoded as a same-weapon flavor swap (trueNormals) so the S1 True Damage 48.62% applies to normals only inside the window. The flavor swap does NOT refill the mag at either end, so there is no shot-count optimism. True swap normals retain crit and core in the engine (true damage critting is owner-ruled in-game-confirmed); whether true damage should CORE is an engine-fidelity ⚑ out of this override's domain — unverified in-game, and SMG coreMult 250 makes it a large lever.
